# `pacvamp build-env update`

- **Usage:** `pacvamp build-env update <FLAGS> <ROOT>`

Clone and update an image into a new destination, preserving the original

## Arguments
- **`<ROOT>`**

## Flags
- **`--destination <DESTINATION>`**
- **`--package <PACKAGE>`**
- **`-y --yes`**
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
